buildings.name: Library
buildings.unlockedMessage: The seals break... You have unlocked Cole Library, where knowledge and quiet whispers guard the soul's forgotten words.
buildings.description: Cole Library is the academic heart of Cornell College, offering vast resources, quiet study spaces, and a view that inspires endless curiosity.

buildings.name: McWethy
buildings.unlockedMessage: The colors return... McWethy Hall awakens, where the soul once painted their memories into the fabric of time.
buildings.description: McWethy Hall is home to Cornell’s art and theater programs, where creativity thrives in studios, galleries, and performance spaces.

buildings.name: PR
buildings.unlockedMessage: The silence lifts... Pauly Rorem opens, revealing where the soul dreamed restless dreams under moonlit nights.
buildings.description: Pauly Rorem is a welcoming residence hall, offering a close-knit community for students living on the Hilltop campus.

buildings.name: Ebersole
buildings.unlockedMessage: The healing hum returns... Ebersole opens, where the soul once sought comfort when hope began to fade.
buildings.description: The Ebersole Health & Wellness Center provides physical and mental health support for all Cornell students, offering a safe space for care and recovery.

buildings.name: Stoner
buildings.unlockedMessage: The winds shift... Stoner House welcomes you, where the soul found kinship among voices from every corner of the world.
buildings.description: Stoner House serves as the hub for international students, celebrating diversity and fostering global community on campus.

buildings.name: TC
buildings.unlockedMessage: The echoes awaken... Thomas Commons opens, where the soul once gathered, laughed, and lingered in the heart of campus life.
buildings.description: Thomas Commons is the central hub of Cornell College, offering dining, gathering spaces, and student resources for every part of campus life.
